name: Kairos-Wake Bridge
description: Delegate tasks to Kairos-Wake wakers and optionally emit signed lifecycle events for Wake tracing.

authToken.description: Bearer token for Kairos-Wake API authentication; prefer SecretRef or KAIROS_WAKE_BRIDGE_TOKEN

defaultWaker.description: Default waker ID to use when none is specified

eventsEnabled.description: Enable signed OpenClaw lifecycle events to Wake

eventSecret.description: Shared secret used to sign event envelopes; inject through the secret manager

agentId.description: Optional OpenClaw agent identity override for event envelopes

wakerId.description: Optional Wake waker identity attached to event envelopes

enabled.label: Enable Kairos-Wake Bridge
enabled.help: Globally enable or disable the Kairos-Wake bridge tools.

daemonUrl.label: Daemon URL
daemonUrl.help: URL of the Kairos-Wake daemon. Defaults to http://127.0.0.1:19900.

authToken.label: Wake bridge service token
authToken.help: Prefer a SecretRef or the KAIROS_WAKE_BRIDGE_TOKEN environment variable; never paste a clear token into openclaw.json.

defaultWaker.label: Default Waker
defaultWaker.help: Waker ID to use when the agent does not specify one explicitly.

eventsEnabled.label: Enable Wake Event Tracing
eventsEnabled.help: Emit bounded, signed OpenClaw lifecycle events to Kairos-Wake.

eventSecret.label: Wake event signing secret
eventSecret.help: Use a SecretRef or injected secret; never paste this into chat.
